question: Which of the following educational Institutes won the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar 2021 in the category 'Identification and Nurturing of Budding and Young Talent'?

options.text: Lingayas Institute of Management and Technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**Manav Rachna Educational Institution**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manav Rachna Educational Institution** won the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar 2021 in the category 'Identification and Nurturing of Budding and Young Talent'.
 
• The award recognizes the efforts of organizations in promoting sports and identifying young talents in India.
 
• Manav Rachna Educational Institution has been actively involved in nurturing sports talent through its various programs and initiatives.
 
• The institution provides excellent infrastructure and facilities to support young athletes in their training and development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar** was instituted by the Government of India to encourage the involvement of corporates and institutions in the promotion of sports.
 
• The award is given annually and covers various categories including identification and nurturing of talent, encouragement to sports through corporate social responsibility, and others.
 
• Institutions and organizations across India are recognized for their contributions to the development of sports and athletes.
 
• Manav Rachna Educational Institution's commitment to sports is reflected in its consistent efforts to provide training, scholarships, and opportunities to young athletes.
